text: Your master asks you to find a Soul Lotus to heal his failing health.

outcomes.text: You return with the lotus. He is deeply moved.
Master says nothing, but his eyes dim.

text: Your master lies on his deathbed and calls you close.

outcomes.text: He transfers a lifetime of qi and wisdom into you, grateful for the Soul Lotus you once brought him. He also teaches you the art he never taught another.
He transfers a lifetime of qi and wisdom into you, and presses his old jade pendant into your palm. With his last breath he teaches you the art he never taught another.
